title: Base44 Privacy Policy — collection, purposes, sharing and tracking
source_type: Investigator-provided excerpts attributed to first-party privacy policy; retrieval/authentication pending
date: Privacy Policy last-updated date stated as 2026-09-10; supplied transcript says retrieved 2026-10-07
excerpt: Website Users: “We collect specific types of connection details and information that may identify you, such as your IP address, log and usage data and exact device type and location.” Platform Users: “We collect Personal Information you provide us with when using the Platform, our services and products, including information you provide us to register and log into your account such as name, username, email and payment information, contact details you shared with us when you contact our support, any Personal Information, if any, that you choose to share with the Platform as input data, such as images and video, and log and usage data.” Prospects: “We collect Personal Information we obtain from publicly available sources (e.g., professional networking sites), third-party data providers, or business partners about individuals who have not directly used or engaged our Platform, products and services but may have been identified as potential customers or relevant contacts.” Uses: “To generate anonymized and aggregated metadata”; “To identify, contact, and analyze prospective customers or leads for marketing, business outreach, or internal analytics”; “To investigate violations and enforce our policies (including this policy and our Responsible Use Policy), and as required by law, regulation or other governmental authority, or to comply with a subpoena or similar legal process or respond to a government request or otherwise collaborate with law enforcement agencies”; “To develop new products and services by conducting analytics or research.” Sharing: “We do not rent or sell any Personal Information. We may share Personal Information with the following recipients: Our third-party vendors engaged in providing services in connection with the Platform, Website or sending marketing communications (the latter, with your consent); Our subsidiaries and affiliated companies; Auditors or advisers to Base44's business; and Any potential purchasers of, lenders to or investors in Base44.” Users-of-Users: “Each of our Users on our platform is able to collect information, including Personal Information, about their own application's users (Users-of-Users). All collection or usage of Users-of-Users personal information shall be in accordance with our Data Processing Addendum.”

title: Base44 Privacy Policy — cookies, third-party matching and analytics
source_type: Investigator-provided excerpts attributed to first-party privacy policy; retrieval/authentication pending
date: Privacy Policy last-updated date stated as 2026-09-10; supplied transcript says retrieved 2026-10-07
excerpt: “We use cookies and other technologies in our services, including when you visit our Website or access our Platform.” “Cookies are also used to help ensure that the advertisements you see are relevant to you and to your interests and to compile statistical data on your use of the Platform.” “We may also use cookies in order to associate your activities with other Personal Information found in third party databases, including by association with your email or home address. We (or service providers on our behalf) may then send communications and marketing to these email or home addresses.” “We also use a tool called Google Analytics to collect information about your use of the Platform and Website. ... Google Analytics collects the IP address assigned to you on the date you visit sites, rather than your name or other identifying information.”
